items.heading: Before you record
items.body:
- Mount your phone on the head rig. It should sit firmly — if it shakes / shifts while you move, the recording isn't usable.
- Keep the camera lens unobstructed.
- Pick a well-lit space. Natural daylight or bright indoor lighting both work.
- Close all other apps. Background apps can interrupt recording.
- Pick a task from the **Tasks** tab that matches what you're about to do.

items.heading: Check your framing first
items.body: The moment you rotate to landscape, the screen shows a live camera preview — use it BEFORE you tap **Start Recording**. Confirm the head rig is sitting right: your hands should land inside the frame, and the scene you're about to record should be clearly visible. If you can, have someone stand in front of you and check the framing for you. A few seconds here saves a wasted recording — make it a habit.

items.heading: Starting a recording
items.body:
1. Open the task and tap **Start Recording**. The screen rotates to landscape and locks.
2. Bring both hands into the camera frame and hold them there. The progress ring fills as your hands are detected — once it completes, recording starts automatically and you'll hear _"Recording started."_
3. You can also tap **Skip** under the record button to start manually.

items.heading: While recording
items.body:
- Keep your hands in frame as much as possible.
- Follow the per-task instructions on the task screen (gaze direction, pacing, what to focus on).
- The screen dims to save battery and reduce heat. This is normal.
- Minimum length per clip is **60 seconds**. Anything shorter is discarded.

items.heading: Stopping a recording
items.body:
- Tap the stop button. You'll hear _"Recording stopped"_ and see your contribution time added.
- You stay on the recording screen — tap record again to start a new clip of the same task.
- To switch tasks, exit the recording screen and pick a different task.

items.heading: Your first recording (Practice)
items.body: Your first run-through is a 60-second practice. It doesn't upload, doesn't appear in History, and doesn't count toward your contribution. After that, every recording counts.

items.heading: Uploads
items.body:
- Recordings upload automatically once they finish.
- Track progress from the **Pending uploads** tile on Home.
- Uploads continue when the app is in the background.

items.heading: Payouts
items.body:
Payments are processed offline. Your earnings will start reflecting in the app soon. Keep recording — your data is safe and your payouts are guaranteed.

---

items.question: What kind of phone do I need?
items.answer: A phone with a 1080p ultrawide rear camera (≥ 110° field of view), gyroscope and accelerometer sensors, and steady performance under load. We run a one-time compatibility check on first launch — if your phone passes, you're good.

items.question: Why did my phone fail the compatibility check?
items.answer: The check looks at camera resolution, ultrawide field of view, sensor availability and sustained sample rate, microphone, and whether your device is rooted. The screen lists exactly which checks failed.

items.question: Why did the check re-run on my phone?
items.answer: The compatibility check re-runs after every app update or OS update, and the first time you sign in on a new device. This catches changes that could affect capture quality.

items.question: Can I use someone else's phone to record?
items.answer: Yes. As long as the phone passes the compatibility check and you sign in with your own Google account, you can use it.

items.question: Can I record children?
items.answer: No. By signing up you confirm everyone you record is 18 or older. Recordings of minors are not permitted.

items.question: Can I record indoors and outdoors?
items.answer: Yes. Match your task to the setting — some tasks are naturally indoor (cooking, cleaning, laundry); others fit either.

items.question: Why does the app need my location?
items.answer: Approximate location helps us understand the diversity of recordings in our dataset. We use coarse location only — never precise GPS.

items.question: How do I get paid?
items.answer: Payouts run offline initially. Don't worry, your contributions are being tracked — we'll notify you when payouts start reflecting in the app.

items.question: How long can a recording be?
items.answer: Minimum 60 seconds. There's no maximum limit. We'd like you to record the relevant tasks for as long as you can.

items.question: What is the practice recording for?
items.answer: It's a one-time, 60-second run-through to get you familiar with the recording flow. It doesn't upload and doesn't count toward your contribution.

items.question: Can I delete a recording?
items.answer: No. Once recorded, clips stay in your History and upload automatically.

items.question: Can I cancel an upload?
items.answer: No. Uploads run automatically and resume after interruptions. You can see progress from the **Pending uploads** tile on Home.

items.question: Can I watch my recordings?
items.answer: Yes — tap a thumbnail in History to play it back. Once a clip has been securely uploaded and the local copy is cleared, the thumbnail stays but playback is no longer available.

items.question: Does the app use mobile data?
items.answer: Yes by default. Uploads work over both Wi-Fi and cellular.

items.question: Why did my recording stop on its own?
items.answer:
A few things can stop a recording mid-flight:

- The phone rotated out of landscape
- An incoming call was answered, or an alarm went off
- The phone got too warm
- The battery dropped to 5% or below

The app tells you what happened with a toast or voice cue.

items.question: Why can't I find a recording I just made?
items.answer: If it stopped at less than 60 seconds, it was discarded. Otherwise check the **History** tab — clips appear there even while uploads are still in progress.

items.question: How do I delete my account?
items.answer: Profile → Delete account, then type **DELETE** to confirm. Your account is deactivated for **30 days** — log in within that window to restore it. After 30 days, deletion is permanent. Recordings already uploaded remain on our servers.

items.question: What happens if I uninstall the app?
items.answer: Local recordings that haven't uploaded yet are lost. Uploaded recordings stay on our servers and your account is unaffected.

items.question: I requested a new task — when will it appear?
items.answer:
Task requests are reviewed by our team. We'll get back to you as soon as we can.

---

items.heading: Recording won't start
items.resolution:
- _"Phone is too warm"_ — let your phone cool for a few minutes. Remove tight cases that trap heat.
- Battery is below 5% — plug in to charge. New recordings are allowed once you're back above 15%.
- Hand-detection gate isn't passing — see below.

items.heading: The hand-detection gate keeps resetting
items.resolution:
- Both hands must be visible at the same time for about 2 seconds.
- Move toward a light source — low light makes hand detection unreliable.
- Remove gloves or anything covering your hands.
- Tap on **Skip** below the recording button to start recording manually.

items.heading: Camera preview is black
items.resolution:
- Check that camera permission is granted. Settings → Apps → Humyn Labs → Permissions.
- Close any other app using the camera (video calls, other camera apps).
- Restart the app.

items.heading: Recording stopped mid-session
items.resolution:
- Phone rotated out of landscape — keep it locked in landscape on the rig.
- Incoming call was answered, or an alarm fired — these can't be suppressed.
- Phone overheated — let it cool, then try again.
- Battery dropped to 5% — charge before continuing.

items.heading: "Recording too short — discarded"
items.resolution: Clips under 60 seconds aren't saved. Aim for at least a minute per task.

items.heading: Compatibility check failed
items.resolution: The screen lists which checks failed. Most failures are hardware-related and can't be fixed in software. If you're using a borrowed phone, try a different qualifying device. Make sure the phone isn't rooted and was installed from the Play Store.

items.heading: Sign-in failed
items.resolution:
- Check your internet connection.
- The app blocks rooted phones, emulators, and sideloaded builds. If that's the cause, install from the Play Store on a non-rooted phone.
- Try again — Google sign-in occasionally times out.

items.heading: Uploads aren't progressing
items.resolution:
- Check your internet connection.
- On Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, or Samsung phones, the OS sometimes pauses background uploads. Allow the battery-optimization exemption when prompted, or simply reopen the app to resume.
- Uploads pause while you're recording. They resume after stop.

items.heading: Storage warning at compatibility check
items.resolution: Free up at least 5 GB before recording. A 10-minute clip is roughly 600 MB.

items.heading: Phone heats up while recording
items.resolution:
- Some warming is normal, but persistent overheating ends recordings early.
- Remove tight phone cases and avoid recording in direct sunlight.
- Charging while recording can compound heat — record on battery when possible.

items.heading: I switched to a new phone — what do I need to do?
items.resolution: Sign in with the same Google account. The compatibility check will re-run on the new device. Recordings already uploaded from your old phone stay on our servers; local clips that hadn't uploaded yet are tied to the old install and won't appear on the new device.

items.heading: I just deleted my account by mistake
items.resolution:
Log in with the same Google account within 30 days. Your account, profile, and History will be restored. After 30 days, deletion is permanent.

---

contactSupport.headline: Need more help?
contactSupport.body: Still stuck? Tap **Contact Support** below to email us at `support@humynlabs.ai`. Tell us your phone model, what you were trying to do, and roughly when it happened — that's usually enough for us to help.
